title: EU fully rejects US threat to ban diesel exports over strategic reserve dispute
detail: The European Union has fully rejected a US threat to ban diesel exports to Europe unless the bloc releases more fuel from its strategic reserves, escalating a transatlantic dispute over energy supply management. The standoff marks a significant shift in US-EU energy relations as the Trump administration pressures Europe over fuel stock levels.

media.caption: EU rejects US diesel export threat amid transatlantic energy dispute

title: UK minister denies diesel shortage as Trump's export ban threat widens transatlantic fuel dispute
detail: A UK minister denied Britain faces a diesel shortage despite public concern following Trump's threat to ban diesel exports to Europe. The denial came as the broader transatlantic fuel dispute widened, with the EU separately rejecting the US ultimatum over strategic fuel reserves.

media.caption: UK minister denies diesel shortage fears amid Trump export ban threat
